Between these normal faults are blocks, which subside, get uplifted or tilted.","title":"Basin and range topography"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" This is known as block faulting.","title":"Basin and range topography"},{"sentence_id":6,"text":" Basins are formed due to subsidence of a block, while the blocks adjacent to the subsidence gets uplifted creating ranges.","title":"Basin and range topography"},{"sentence_id":7,"text":" Normal faults are on both sides the blocks; creating alternating elevated or subsided blocks, otherwise known as horst and graben.","title":"Basin and range topography"},{"sentence_id":8,"text":" Basins and ranges can also be formed by blocks that are tilted causing one side to subside while the other side gets uplifted.","title":"Basin and range topography"},{"sentence_id":9,"text":" These only have one side with a normal fault, this is known as tilted block faulting.","title":"Basin and range topography"},{"sentence_id":10,"text":" Extension causes the plate to stretch, fracture and thin.","title":"Basin and range topography"},{"sentence_id":11,"text":" Mountains rise and valleys drop, over a long period of time creating what we see as basin and range topography.","title":"Basin and range topography"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"California-style pizza (also known as California pizza or Gourmet pizza) is a style of single-serving pizza that combines New York and Italian thin crust with toppings from the California cuisine cooking style.","title":"California-style pizza"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Its invention is generally attributed to chef Ed LaDou, and Chez Panisse, in Berkeley, California.","title":"California-style pizza"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Wolfgang Puck, after meeting LaDou, popularized the style of pizza in the rest of the country.","title":"California-style pizza"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" It is served in a number of California Cuisine restaurants.","title":"California-style pizza"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" Such restaurant chains as California Pizza Kitchen, Extreme Pizza, and Sammy's Woodfired Pizza are three major pizza franchises associated with California-style pizza.","title":"California-style pizza"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" Nancy Silverton's Pizzeria Mozza is also a popular California-style pizza restaurant in Los Angeles.","title":"California-style pizza"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":null,"question":"Are both Upper Crust Pizzeria and Eatza Pizza restaurants?"}
